visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of padded colored tiles, each with a small line icon, heading, short description and a bottom-pinned link
visualCharacteristics.layout: three tiles per row on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile; equal-height tiles with the link pinned to the bottom
visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White section; each tile has a sky-blue background, generous padding, black line icon; a tile may carry a footnote/tooltip disclosure after the text

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 icon image; cell 2 text (heading, description, CTA link)
contentPattern.reason: Repeating look-alike items (icon, title, text, link) that flow in a row and wrap on mobile
contentPattern.variantReason: Padded colored tiles with a small line icon above heading, text and bottom-pinned link

usage: Use for a set of feature/benefit tiles with an icon, heading, text and one link each.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any icon-led tile row. Use cards-logo for image-only logo grids and the base cards block for photo cards.
